python - <<'PY'
import json, math
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap, Normalize
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    d=json.load(f)

sp={r['country']:r['edu_spending_pct_gdp'] for r in d['education_spending']['data']}
rg={r['country']:r['region'] for r in d['education_spending']['data']}
ps={r['country']:r['pisa_avg'] for r in d['pisa_scores']['data']}
en={r['country']:r['enrollment_rate'] for r in d['tertiary_enrollment']['data']}
yu={r['country']:r['youth_unemp_rate'] for r in d['youth_unemployment']['data']}

countries=sorted(set(sp)&set(ps)&set(en)&set(yu))

x=np.array([sp[c] for c in countries])
y=np.array([ps[c] for c in countries])
s=np.array([en[c] for c in countries])
c=np.array([yu[c] for c in countries])

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(16,10),dpi=220)

# Editorial colormap: low unemployment blue -> high unemployment red
cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('editorial_unemp', ['#1f4e79','#3b82a6','#8fb9c9','#f2b8a0','#d96b5f','#9b2226'])
norm=Normalize(vmin=float(c.min()), vmax=float(c.max()))

# Bubble sizes (area)
size=((s - s.min())/(s.max()-s.min())*1800)+220

sc=ax.scatter(x,y,s=size,c=c,cmap=cmap,norm=norm,alpha=0.88,edgecolors='#1f2937',linewidths=0.9)

# Quadrant reference lines (median-based) to surface mixed outcomes/outliers
mx=float(np.median(x)); my=float(np.median(y))
ax.axvline(mx,color='#6b7280',linestyle=(0,(4,4)),linewidth=1.0,alpha=0.8)
ax.axhline(my,color='#6b7280',linestyle=(0,(4,4)),linewidth=1.0,alpha=0.8)

# Smooth trend line to show nonlinearity/scatter prominence
coef=np.polyfit(x,y,2)
xx=np.linspace(x.min()-0.1,x.max()+0.1,250)
yy=np.polyval(coef,xx)
ax.plot(xx,yy,color='#111827',linewidth=2.2,alpha=0.9,label='Quadratic fit (PISA vs spending)')

# Label notable countries per goal
notable = {
    'high_spenders_mixed':['Norway','Denmark','Sweden','Finland','Costa Rica'],
    'efficiency_outliers':['Japan','South Korea','Singapore','Estonia','Poland'],
    'labor_disconnect':['Spain','Greece','Italy','Chile','Portugal']
}
label_set=set(sum(notable.values(),[]))

offsets={
    'Norway':(6,8),'Denmark':(6,-12),'Sweden':(6,8),'Finland':(6,-10),'Costa Rica':(8,8),
    'Japan':(6,8),'South Korea':(6,-12),'Singapore':(6,8),'Estonia':(6,8),'Poland':(6,-12),
    'Spain':(6,8),'Greece':(6,-12),'Italy':(6,8),'Chile':(6,-12),'Portugal':(6,8)
}
for i,country in enumerate(countries):
    if country in label_set:
        dx,dy=offsets.get(country,(6,6))
        ax.annotate(country,(x[i],y[i]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(dx,dy),fontsize=9.5,color='#111827',fontweight='semibold',
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.16',fc='white',ec='none',alpha=0.75))

# Axes, title, subtitle
ax.set_title('Education Spending vs Outcomes Across 30 Countries',fontsize=21,fontweight='bold',loc='left',pad=18,color='#111827')
ax.text(0.0,1.02,'X: Public education spending (% of GDP) • Y: PISA 2022 average score • Bubble size: tertiary enrollment (%) • Color: youth unemployment (%)',
        transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=11.5,color='#374151')

ax.set_xlabel('Education Spending (% of GDP)',fontsize=13,fontweight='semibold',labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('PISA Average Score (points)',fontsize=13,fontweight='semibold',labelpad=10)

ax.set_xlim(x.min()-0.25,x.max()+0.35)
ax.set_ylim(y.min()-8,y.max()+8)
ax.tick_params(axis='both',labelsize=11)

# Colorbar legend for unemployment
cbar=fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm=norm,cmap=cmap),ax=ax,pad=0.02,shrink=0.9)
cbar.set_label('Youth Unemployment Rate (% of labor force ages 15–24)',fontsize=11)
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=10)

# Bubble size legend (enrollment)
for val in [50,75,100]:
    ax.scatter([],[],s=((val - s.min())/(s.max()-s.min())*1800)+220,c='#9ca3af',alpha=0.5,edgecolors='#4b5563',linewidths=0.8,label=f'{val}% tertiary enrollment')

leg=ax.legend(frameon=True,facecolor='white',edgecolor='#d1d5db',fontsize=10,loc='lower right',title='Bubble Size',title_fontsize=10)

# Footnote/source
ax.text(0.0,-0.12,'Source: /app/benchmark/source_data.json (World Bank/OECD/ILO-based country indicators, circa 2022–2023).',
        transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=9.5,color='#4b5563')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png',bbox_inches='tight')
PY
